mods.name: CytraBackups
mods.description: Deduplicating world backups for technical servers: chunk-level dedup, zstd, scheduled backups with GFS pruning, safe full and partial (chunk) restores with recycle-bin rollback, off-site copies and Discord notifications. Server-side; the optional client GUI is in the same jar.
